en.topic_title: Firefighters receive 179 reports of people trapped in lifts after sudden voltage dip
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong firefighters have received over 200 reports of people trapped in lifts and falsely triggered fire alarms after a sudden drop in voltage along a Kowloon power supply line on Tuesday afternoon.



CLP Power. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.



The Fire Services Department (FSD) said it had handled 179 cases of lift entrapment and 39 false alarms as of 3pm on Tuesday, following a flurry of reports after 1.10pm that was mostly concentrated in Yau Tsim Mong district.
